svg.title: Protected token release: 11 of 16 implementation-detail units landed, 1 in progress, 4 other open. Row 11 private consume authorization and issuance is source-landed; row 12 reservation and pending admission is in progress with source foundations.
svg.desc: Detail inside activation step 20. Units 01 current proofs and effects, 02 metadata-only key custody, 03 read acquisition, 04 completed-activation provenance, 05 fresh state observation and 06 signed plan with stateless owner are committed source. Units 07 consume-history custody, 08 durable plan retention and 09 root-admitted cold planner construction are source-landed in 658c59eabfffb8ed7f17525c9efbe16f527cfd34. Unit 10 cold planner launcher and private service is source-landed in d7336814d65d81ad070dbab1d55715f7e6ca2cd8. Unit 11 private consume authorization and issuance is source-landed with all 12 named substeps landed, none in progress or open. A01–A03 foundations landed in f6dd3cba33fc64670fa78c5dc1bd225b3bb54ef8; A04–A08 first-exact storage, verified export, root-controlled key/storage delivery, cold planner connection and private export service landed in 0ef6024f5d0cf56e865fa39ee767ac57739055e0. A09 receiving-purpose key custody and A10 independent original-proof replay landed in b3c9a58472b788b8f06e3824cd57b6f345ecf6c2. A11 actual consume-grant issuance and verification and all five diagnostic components landed in 4b421e2d26777b904ebe807fcd9dce367a8826f6. A12 dedicated cold grant service and row 11 closure landed in 8ac2374000de874efb1ededa1a65037d5460b18d. Row 12 reservation and pending admission is IN PROGRESS: purpose-separated custody, reservation/pending replay, durable ACK delivery, state v8 and reserver bootstrap foundations landed in 4d4091c72543477823ff4031bfac60e03d79b925. Cold reserver OS/startup and the actual cold SQL pending consumer remain open within row 12. Units 13 one-use protected consume SQL, 14 durable completion and recovery, 15 exact committed-original token release and 16 cold release response and handoff remain OPEN. Group c has 9/12 landed, 1 in progress and 2 other open; its grouping parent remains in progress. Diagnostic groups remain 2/5, activation 19/26 and parents 34/46. All nested counts are nonadditive, not an effort percentage; landed source is not runtime evidence. No runtime or production claim. Source is uninstalled, unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned; production gates remain 0/6 verified.
